Quick summary: our app saw sustained tail usage over the last 6 weeks and our current dedicated tranche is hitting 95th-percentile limits during our weekday peaks. I've attached the usage report (CSV->PDF) and trimmed p0 logs. We are evaluating options ahead of our December renewal.

We want to avoid recurring latency escalations — three incidents in Oct/Nov caused customer-facing delays. High-level asks:
- Recommendation for reserve sizing that keeps 95th pct latency stable during peak windows
- A plan to translate our observed quantile usage into tranche adjustments (how many GPUs reserved vs burst)
- Estimation of cost delta and lead time if we move GPUs from burst to reserved capacity

Initial ask: can Redwood run a quantile-based forecast and propose a tranche reassignment for the next 12 months? We'd like a short proposal by EOD Thursday (19 Nov) to align with our procurement window.

Sara — thanks for the note and the attachments. I've pulled the report and skimmed the trimmed logs. High-level reaction up front: your 95th-percentile token throughput is ~2.7x above the committed slot baseline during peak minutes and your prefix cache hit rate drops under sustained multi-shard batches. Two immediate levers that will materially reduce p95 latency:

1) Convert a portion of current burst GPUs into reserved tranche (smoother KV cache locality and lower cold-starts)
2) Apply a tailored quantization profile for a small subset of models to reclaim throughput while validating output quality

What I'll deliver by Thurs: a quantile-forecast (50/75/90/95/99) mapped to GPU counts, a tranche reassignment plan (suggested reserved vs burst split per quarter), and a short cost delta table.

Quick clarifying Qs for Helix: can you confirm the percentage of inference traffic that must stay on the 8k token window models vs your newer 2k optimized ones? That split changes GPU footprint materially.

Ben — looping you for list price delta and lead time if customer signs a 12-month amendment for reserved GPUs. Kimberly — would you own the rollout / canary cadence and monitoring playbook once we reassign tranche?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Account Solutions
Redwood Inference
